ItemID: 1; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These could complement my UNC rivet nuts for fastening panels, though I would check the required length first.
ItemID: 2; Title: 5/16 x 5-1/2" (8 pcs) Hex Lag Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Hexagon Head Lag Bolts, Hex Head Wood Screws; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do wood repairs, but I have no current need for lag screws this long.
ItemID: 3; Title: AmazonCommercial 44 Gallon Heavy Duty Round Trash/Garbage Can, Grey, 4-pck; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Four large trash cans are more than I need for my DIY work.
ItemID: 4; Title: M3-0.5 x 12mm (100 PCS) Socket Head Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 12.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Coarse Thread UNC, DIN 912; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Small socket screws fit my projects, but my existing metric assortment may already cover this size, and I would verify the thread specification.
ItemID: 5; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current pressure-system project that needs this gauge.
ItemID: 6; Title: VIGRUE 310 Pcs #6 1/2'' to 1'' #8 1/2'' to 1-1/2'' Wood Screws Black Oxide Coated Stainless Steel Flat Head Phillips Drywall Screw Assortment Kit, Self Tapping Screws Kit in 8 Sizes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The range of short screws looks useful for everyday repairs, and I frequently use fastener assortments.
ItemID: 7; Title: Realth Magnets Disc Neodymium 0.79” x 0.08” 10 Pack Round Permanent Rare Earth Magnetic for Fridge Office Science Project Craft(MC20210); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These could be useful for craft fixtures or closures, but I do not have a specific use for them today.
ItemID: 8; Title: Mornajina Dial Indicator with Magnetic Base 0-10mm Tester Gage, Dial Test Indicator 0.01mm Precision, Magnetic Dial Indicator Base Holder with Fine Adjustment; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Measurement tools interest me, but my caliper covers my current needs and I am not checking machine alignment right now.
ItemID: 9; Title: M6-1.0 x 16mm (30 PCS) Countersunk Head Socket Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 10.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, DIN 7991; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A flush-head option could complement my M6 hardware for assemblies where protruding bolt heads get in the way.
ItemID: 10; Title: #6 (100 pcs) Stainless Steel Spring Lock Washers, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8 Regular helical Spring Lock washers, ASME/ANSI B18.21.1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my interest in assembly hardware, but I would check whether I need #6 washers before buying a hundred.
